answer: In reciprocity-weighted EigenTrust, reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so influence must be maintained through sustained honest service. A freshly spawned sybil has little trusted incoming mass and therefore near-zero eigenvector centrality; multiplying identities cannot create reciprocal endorsements, leaving consensus thresholds unmet until credible peers vouch for them. Even a falcon that may wander the graph cannot turn pigment-thin history into trust.
